metadata.name: regions
metadata.description: Region governance, operator seats, and locations for the realXmarket protocol

docs: Region governance for the realXmarket protocol: a regional operator proposes
a region by bonding XCAV, holders vote, and on a pass the proposer claims it
and becomes the operator. A seat turns over at the end of the operator's term
(or earlier through resignation), after which any operator can claim the open
region by bonding and the incumbent can renew. On top of the seat governance
the region carries the marketplace's static data: registered locations
(postcodes), the property sale tax, and the listing duration.

instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Complete the authority handover. Signed by the pending authority.

instructions.name: adjust_listing_duration
docs: Change how long new listings in the region stay active. Region-operator-only.

instructions.name: adjust_region_tax
docs: Change the region's property sale tax. Region-operator-only.

instructions.name: claim_open_region
docs: Claim an open region seat, bonding 0.1% of XCAV supply plus the region's
location deposits, capped by the caller's `max_deposit`. First-come and
RegionalOperator-only; the incumbent may also call this to renew, paying
only the difference if the bond has moved since they last bonded.

accounts.name: old_owner_token
docs: returned collateral on a takeover. Created idempotently (the ATA
program verifies the derivation), so an outgoing operator closing their
account can't make the seat uncontestable. Unused when the incumbent
renews (they are refunded through `new_operator_token` instead).

docs: Close a rejected/empty region state so the region can be proposed again.

program verifies the derivation), so a closed account can't wedge the
crank and lock the region forever.

instructions.name: create_new_location

region's collateral.

types.name: AccessPermission
docs: Compliance status for a (user, role) assignment, set by an admin after
off-chain KYC/AML. Only the marketplace's investor-fund calls (listing,
buying, offers, share transfers, lawyer case work) require this flag on
top of the role; every other instruction checks role possession alone.
Later it'll be driven by a SAS attestation instead of a manual toggle.
Do not reorder the variants: the serialized `RoleAccount.permission`
stores the variant index, so a reorder flips every stored status.

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton config holding governance parameters and the authority.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority allowed to update parameters.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Proposed replacement authority; takes over via `accept_authority`.
Two-step so a typo'd address can't brick parameter management.

fields.name: xcav_mint
docs: The XCAV governance mint staked for proposals, votes, and operator bonds.

fields.name: minimum_voting_amount
docs: Minimum XCAV a voter must lock to vote.

fields.name: voting_period
docs: Seconds a proposal stays open for voting.

fields.name: owner_change_period
docs: The operator's term: minimum time before a region's seat can be claimed
by someone else, and how long a passed proposal has to be claimed.

fields.name: threshold_bps
docs: Approval threshold in basis points (yes / (yes + no)).

fields.name: quorum
docs: Minimum total voting power for a proposal to be valid.

fields.name: notice_period
docs: Notice an operator must give before resigning (seconds).

fields.name: min_vote_hold
docs: Seconds before a proposal's expiry after which new votes are rejected,
so every vote's lock lasts at least this long.

fields.name: max_listing_duration
docs: Longest listing duration an operator may set for their region (seconds).

fields.name: max_tax_bps
docs: Highest property tax an operator may set, in basis points.

fields.name: location_deposit
docs: XCAV an operator locks per registered location, on top of their bond.

fields.name: proposal_counter
docs: Monotonic id for the next proposal.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Governance parameters for the regions program.

types.name: Location
docs: A registered postcode within a region. Existence is the point: the
marketplace requires a listing's location PDA to exist for its region.

fields.name: postcode
docs: The postcode, as seeded (uppercase ASCII, no spaces).

fields.name: deposit
docs: The XCAV locked when the location was registered. Released on removal,
even if the configured deposit has changed since.

types.name: Region
docs: A created region and its operator.

fields.name: collateral
docs: The operator's bonded XCAV plus the location deposits, held in the
vault. Returned when the seat changes hands.

fields.name: location_collateral
docs: The part of `collateral` backing the registered locations: the sum of
every `Location.deposit`. Takeovers and removals move these recorded
amounts, so the seat's bond stays exactly what was locked no matter
how the configured deposit changes in between.

fields.name: listing_duration
docs: Seconds a property listing in this region stays active.

fields.name: tax_bps
docs: Property sale tax for this region, in basis points.

fields.name: location_count
docs: Number of registered locations (each backed by a location deposit).

types.name: RegionProposal
docs: An open proposal to create a region, with its running vote tally. The
proposer's bond is held in the vault and tracked on the region's
`RegionState`; this account only carries the vote.

fields.name: vote_cutoff
docs: Votes are rejected from this moment on, so every vote's lock lasts at
least the configured minimum hold. Snapshotted at propose time; a
config change never shrinks an open proposal's window.

types.name: RegionState
docs: One account per region tracking its pre-creation lifecycle. Created when a
region is proposed and kept (transitioning Proposing -> Passed/Rejected)
until the region is created or the state is cleared. Having exactly one of
these per region is what enforces a single in-flight proposal at a time.

fields.name: proposal_id
docs: The proposal this region is voting on.

fields.name: proposer
docs: The proposer; on a pass they claim the region, on a stale pass they are
refunded the bond.

fields.name: deposit
docs: The proposer's bonded XCAV, held in the vault. Becomes the region's
collateral on claim, or is refunded on reject / stale pass.

fields.name: claim_deadline
docs: Once `Passed`, the deadline for the proposer to claim; after it anyone
can clear the state and the bond is returned.

types.name: RegionStatus
docs: Where a region is in its lifecycle before it is created.

types.name: Role
docs: All roles recognised across the realXmarket protocol.
A role is app-level authorization, separate from KYC/compliance. Compliance
lives in [`AccessPermission`], and will eventually be driven by SAS
attestations rather than a manually set flag.
Do not reorder the variants: the serialized `RoleAccount.role` stores the
variant index, so a reorder reinterprets every existing assignment.

types.name: RoleAccount
docs: One (user, role) assignment together with its compliance status.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid the account's rent (the assigning admin); every teardown
refunds them, whoever triggers it.

types.name: Vote
docs: How a voter can vote on a proposal.

types.name: VoteRecord
docs: One voter's vote on a proposal. The locked voting power (XCAV) is held in the
vault and returned when the voter unlocks. `expiry` is copied from the
proposal so unlocking never needs the proposal account (which may already be
closed by finalization).

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: PDA seed for the singleton config.

constants.name: LOCATION_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a registered location (postcode) within a region.

constants.name: PROPOSAL_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a region proposal.

constants.name: REGION_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a created region.

constants.name: REGION_STATE_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a region's lifecycle state (enforces one in-flight at a time).

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: PDA seed for the protocol's XCAV vault (holds all staked governance
tokens: proposal bonds, vote locks, and region collateral).

constants.name: VOTE_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a single voter's vote on a proposal.
